title: sabulina macra
intro: Sabulina macra, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Crassulaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve mood, and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Sabulina macra include its ability to soothe skin irritations, calm digestive issues, and even support respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
